description: Chrome web browser. The address bar (omnibox) accepts URLs and search terms.
tips: To open a website: hotkey ctrl+l (focuses and selects the address bar), type_text the URL followed by \n.
To search Google from anywhere: ctrl+l, then type the search terms followed by \n.
On a Google results page, organic results are links with a heading (h3) title; skip items labelled Sponsored/Ad and the 'People also ask' box.
The first result is the first non-sponsored result title link below the search box.
After clicking a link, wait until the page title changes before judging the result.
If a cookie or sign-in popup covers the page, dismiss it (Reject all / No thanks / Escape) before continuing.
Never sign in or type passwords; ask the user instead.
